title: Coeff_G(B(Σ), Φ) with axioms (EC1)–(EC4)
body_html:
$G$-equivariant coefficient systems $\Coeff_G(\BSigma, \Phi)$

Following Schneider–Stuhler, $\mathscr{V} \in \Coeff_G(\BSigma)$ is the data:

(EC1) for each facet $\mathcal{F}$ of $\BSigma$, an $R$-module $\mathscr{V}_\mathcal{F}$;

(EC2) for $\mathcal{E} \subseteq \overline{\mathcal{F}}$, a restriction $r^\mathcal{F}_\mathcal{E} : \mathscr{V}_\mathcal{F} \to \mathscr{V}_\mathcal{E}$ with $r^\mathcal{F}_\mathcal{F} = \id$ and $r^\mathcal{F'}_\mathcal{E} \circ r^\mathcal{F}_\mathcal{F'} = r^\mathcal{F'}_\mathcal{E}$ for $\mathcal{E} \subseteq \overline{\mathcal{F}} \subseteq \overline{\mathcal{F'}}$;

(EC3) for $g \in G$, $\mathcal{F}$, an isomorphism $g_\mathcal{F} : \mathscr{V}_\mathcal{F} \to \mathscr{V}_{g\mathcal{F}}$ with $g_{h\mathcal{F}} \circ h_\mathcal{F} = (gh)_\mathcal{F}$, $e_\mathcal{F} = \id$, and the standard equivariance square $r^{g\mathcal{F}}{g\mathcal{E}} \circ g\mathcal{F} = g_\mathcal{E} \circ r^\mathcal{F}_\mathcal{E}$.

These (EC1)–(EC3) together make each $\mathscr{V}_\mathcal{F}$ into a $\hat K_\mathcal{F}$-representation.

$\Phi$-isotypic refinement. $\Coeff_G(\BSigma, \Phi) \subseteq \Coeff_G(\BSigma)$ is the full subcategory satisfying

(EC4) for each facet $\mathcal{F}$, the $\hat K_\mathcal{F}$-representation $\mathscr{V}_\mathcal{F}$ is $\phi_\mathcal{F}$-isotypic when restricted to $K_{\mathcal{F},+}$.

A $G$-equivariant coefficient system is the same as a functor $\mathscr{V} : [\BSigma / G] \to R\text{-mod}$ (following [Dat, §3.1]); the category $\Coeff_G(\BSigma, \Phi)$ is therefore $\underline{\mathrm{Fun}}([\BSigma/G], R\text{-mod})$ restricted by (EC4).
